name: Default
shortDescription: One self-hosted app for shows, movies and music: browse, request, pick releases, fetch subtitles and send downloads to your existing downloader.

alerts.message: There is no default password: whoever opens the app first becomes the owner. Create the owner account right after deploying.
HolyArrs does not download by itself. It needs an external downloader (qBittorrent, SABnzbd and others), not included here, whose finished files HolyArrs can read under /data.
